faq.q: What is the origin of Gulsum?
faq.a: Gulsum is associated with Arabic. Gulsum is the Turkish form of Arabic كُلْثُوم (Kulthūm), a feminine name borne by members of the Prophet's family.
Yes — the underlying form كُلْثُوم is Arabic.
